def transform(grid):
    base=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    out=[]
    h=len(base)
    for y in range(3*h):
        r=y%h
        if (y//h)%2:
            r=h-1-r
        row=base[r]
        out.append(row+row[::-1])
    return out
print(transform(inp)==out)
